data.narrative:
Destinus is a late-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $400M+ to date. The valuation landscape for this sector includes 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, with notable later-stage competitors including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Stage-progression analysis applies directly to this valuation. Using total capital raised of $400M as a baseline proxy, application of a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for late-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $480M. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while 22 same-sector peers exist, filtering for stage-and-tier consistency yielded fewer than the three datapoints needed for reliable median triangulation, making a broader sector median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $408M to $552M, centered on $480M. This range reflects upside/downside scenarios around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties stem from reliance on a single triangulation method and the absence of tightly matched private comparables at the same stage and valuation tier. The disclosed $400M+ raised provides a floor but leaves material ambiguity around how much of that capital has been deployed, burn rate trajectory, and how recent financials compare to the investor base. Refined valuation would benefit from access to contemporaneous operating metrics and updated fundraising or transaction data from Defense & Security peers in the $400M–$600M band.
